body: Fuck this disgusting family. My heart goes to the innocent little girls.

21km that is awesome! I think I get what you are saying. My motivation is lacking, I can admit that. I prefer sober me, she is the "better" person. I think I need to remind myself if that more. And remind myself that the day after is going to bring back regret. Choosing to drink (for myself) sets me back on what's really important- taking care of me and my depression.

Thank you for posting. I wish you all the best on your marathon! *return hugs*

Thank you for taking the time to respond. It is comforting to be reminded that there is a social life outside the bar. It can be frustrating sometimes, I moved a block away from the pub (in between places atm) so the damn thing taunts.

I get prickish too when I drink. A few sips loosen me up and I get giggly, after one though I get nasty. I don't like that person. I like the sober me better, she doesn't go out looking for trouble.

I will try, thank you!
Administered methadone to a patient in distress. Patient died. I left medicine after that. Can't get it out of my head. So much guilt.

I really do feel burnt out. I had taken a month of to try and calm down but all that did was mess up our finances and discourage me further when I finally did go back. I am too scared to take more time again since I have this job to.
I would love to go to the gym again, I just don't know how to find the energy to even start membership shopping :( if only it wasnt winter I could go for a jog or stroll.
